Se_Star_I_GoldRiskAndReturn.description: Erhöht Gold gained from kills um 15% , but du lose 2% Gold when taking Schaden from an Gegner.

Se_Star_I_KillGoldBonus.name: Wealth Accumulation
Se_Star_I_KillGoldBonus.description: Erhöht den amount of Gold gained from defeating Gegner um 4% .

Se_Star_I_MawDiscountAndProtection.name: Sparkling Clean Maw
Se_Star_I_MawDiscountAndProtection.description: Verringert den cost of den Maw of Doom um 20% . Der Maw no longer destroys items it consumes, stattdessen resetting their Stufe or quality.

Se_Star_I_MoreShopItems.name: Monstrous Charm
Se_Star_I_MoreShopItems.description: There is a 50% chance for Jonas to offer 2 additional items for sale.

Se_Star_I_MoreShrineItems.name: Liminal Expansion
Se_Star_I_MoreShrineItems.description: Retrospection Remnant und Enlightenment Remnant have a 50% chance to offer one additional choice.

Se_Star_I_ShopDiscount.name: Sharp Negotiator
Se_Star_I_ShopDiscount.description: Der Gold price of items sold um Händler wird verringert um 10% .

Se_Star_I_ShopRefreshToken.name: Black Market
Se_Star_I_ShopRefreshToken.description: Erhalte 1 Platinum Coins at den start of an Abenteuers und whenever du move to a new Welt, up to a maximum of 3. Use these coins to refresh den Händler's inventory.

Se_Star_I_StartGold.name: Initial Capital
Se_Star_I_StartGold.description: Erhalte 50 Gold at den start of deine Abenteuers.

Se_Star_I_StartSkill.name: Intersecting Memories
Se_Star_I_StartSkill.description: Acquire a random Stufe 1 Erinnerung at den start of deine Abenteuers.

Se_Star_L_ArmorOnTravel.name: Ragged Armor
Se_Star_L_ArmorOnTravel.description: Erhalte 2.5 Rüstung every time du enter a new Welt.

Se_Star_L_DamageReductionFromChilled.name: Cold Affinity
Se_Star_L_DamageReductionFromChilled.description: Schaden erlitten from Gegner afflicted mit Chill wird verringert um 25% .

Se_Star_L_DodgeCooldownOnLowHealth.name: Instinctive Movement
Se_Star_L_DodgeCooldownOnLowHealth.description: When Lebenskraft is below 50%, Dodge Abklingzeit wird verringert um 20% .

Se_Star_L_ElementalResistance.name: Elemental Resistance
Se_Star_L_ElementalResistance.description: Verringert den duration of elemental effects on du um 40% . For Verbrennung, Schaden is reduced .

Se_Star_L_FatalHitProtection.name: Second Wind
Se_Star_L_FatalHitProtection.description: Wenn du tödlichen Schaden erleidest, ignorierst du diesen und wirst für 1 Sekunden unverwundbar. This can only occur once per game.

Se_Star_L_GuidanceShrineDiscount.name: Unconditional Love
Se_Star_L_GuidanceShrineDiscount.description: Verringert den cost of Shrine of Guidance um 25% .

Se_Star_L_HealOnAttack.name: Wicked Vitality
Se_Star_L_HealOnAttack.description: Standardangriffe stellt her 0.40% of deine Maximale Lebenskraft bei Treffer. This Heilung ist erhöht um 150% on a Kritischer Treffer.

Se_Star_L_HealOnKill.name: Combat First Aid
Se_Star_L_HealOnKill.description: Restore 1.00% of deine Maximale Lebenskraft whenever du kill an Gegner.

Se_Star_L_IgnoreDelusion.name: Anchor to Reality
Se_Star_L_IgnoreDelusion.description: Ignore a Delusion effect alle 15 Sekunden.

Se_Star_L_PeriodicScalingArmor.name: Layered Scales
Se_Star_L_PeriodicScalingArmor.description: Erhalte 7 Defense for every 3 Welten visited.

Se_Star_L_PotionChance.name: Asclepius
Se_Star_L_PotionChance.description: Erhöht den chance for a Lebenskraft Potion to appear um 25% .

Se_Star_L_PotionHealAmount.name: Suspicious Mixture
Se_Star_L_PotionHealAmount.description: Erhöht den Heilung amount of Lebenskraft Potions um 55% .

Se_Star_L_PotionOnBuyOrSell.name: Humble Freebie
Se_Star_L_PotionOnBuyOrSell.description: Erhalte a Lebenskraft Potion when du buy or sell an item at den shop. This can trigger up to 1 times per merchant.

Se_Star_L_ReceivedHealingAndShieldBonus.name: Regenerative Skin
Se_Star_L_ReceivedHealingAndShieldBonus.description: Erhöht received Healing und Barriere amounts um 12% .

Se_Star_L_ScalingMaxHealth.name: Steel Refinement
Se_Star_L_ScalingMaxHealth.description: Erhöht Maximale Lebenskraft um 15 jedes Mal du Stufenaufstieg.

Se_Star_L_TempArmor.name: Unfounded Confidence
Se_Star_L_TempArmor.description: Erhalte 7 Defense for den first 2 Welten.

Se_Star_Aurena_D_BonusStatOnLowHp.name: Resonance Effect
Se_Star_Aurena_D_BonusStatOnLowHp.description: When deine Lebenskraft is below 50%, deine Angriffskraft und Zauberkraft erhöhen um 8% .

Se_Star_Aurena_F_CR_EarnGold.name: Master Alchemist
Se_Star_Aurena_F_CR_EarnGold.description: Chain Reaction earns 2 Gold pro Sekunde for each Gegner inside den sigil.

Se_Star_Aurena_F_CR_GlobalHeal.name: Golden Mind
Se_Star_Aurena_F_CR_GlobalHeal.description: Chain Reaction applies 70% Heilung to Reisende even if they are not inside den sigil.

Se_Star_Aurena_F_CR_NoHealCooldownReduct.name: Golden Wind
Se_Star_Aurena_F_CR_NoHealCooldownReduct.description: Chain Reaction no longer heilt, but its Abklingzeit wird verringert um 15% jedes Mal an Gegner dies from den sigil.

Se_Star_Aurena_F_DT_LowerThresholdBigger.name: Extremely Dangerous Theory
Se_Star_Aurena_F_DT_LowerThresholdBigger.description: Der Lebenskraft threshold for empowered casts of Dangerous Theory is reduced to 40%, but Heilung ist erhöht um 40%.

Se_Star_Aurena_F_DT_TwiceWithPenalty.name: Follow-up Research
Se_Star_Aurena_F_DT_TwiceWithPenalty.description: Dangerous Theory's Abklingzeit erhöht sich um 1 seconds und it can only be used as an verstärkten Zauber, but it empowers 2 Standardangriffe.

Se_Star_Aurena_F_DT_UnstoppableAndRemove.name: Unparalleled Genius
Se_Star_Aurena_F_DT_UnstoppableAndRemove.description: When du cast Dangerous Theory, become Unstoppable für 1.5 Sekunden und remove Delusional effects.

Se_Star_Aurena_F_GB_LessDamageLessSacrif.name: Loose Dismantle
Se_Star_Aurena_F_GB_LessDamageLessSacrif.description: Golden Explosion's Schaden wird verringert um 40%, but den Lebenskraft sacrificed is also verringert um 30%.

Se_Star_Aurena_F_GB_NoSacrificeAfterDodg.name: Dismantle, Dissolve, Understanding
Se_Star_Aurena_F_GB_NoSacrificeAfterDodg.description: If du cast Golden Explosion within 3 seconds after using Dodge, no Lebenskraft is sacrificed. This only applies im Kampf.

Se_Star_Aurena_F_GB_NoWitherNoSacrifice.name: Strong Bond
Se_Star_Aurena_F_GB_NoWitherNoSacrifice.description: If du cast Golden Explosion mit no Wither stacks, no Lebenskraft is sacrificed. This only applies im Kampf.

Se_Star_Aurena_F_RE_AtkEffect.name: Sharp Shards
Se_Star_Aurena_F_RE_AtkEffect.description: Each Gold Shard from Reduction löst Angriffseffekte aus on den first getroffener Gegner.

Se_Star_Aurena_F_RE_CooldownButNoHeal.name: Transmutation
Se_Star_Aurena_F_RE_CooldownButNoHeal.description: Reduction no longer stellt her Lebenskraft, but its Abklingzeit wird verringert um 70%.

Se_Star_Aurena_F_RE_MoreProjMoreSacrific.name: Enhanced Dismantling Force
Se_Star_Aurena_F_RE_MoreProjMoreSacrific.description: Reduction fires 1 more Gold Shards, but den amount of Lebenskraft sacrificed increases to 15%.

Se_Star_Aurena_I_BonusFromStones.name: Component Analysis
Se_Star_Aurena_I_BonusFromStones.description: Erhöht den resources gained from Gold Shards und Traumstaub Shards um 40% .

Se_Star_Aurena_I_GoldEveryZone.name: Glittering Golden Antlers
Se_Star_Aurena_I_GoldEveryZone.description: Erhalte 60 Gold every time du enter a new Welt.

Se_Star_Aurena_I_GoldOnMerchantDamage.name: Fun Experiment
Se_Star_Aurena_I_GoldOnMerchantDamage.description: Erhalte 4 Gold jedes Mal du Schaden a Händler, up to a maximum of 40 Gold.

Se_Star_Aurena_I_PotionGold.name: Equivalent Exchange
Se_Star_Aurena_I_PotionGold.description: Erhalte 10 Gold jedes Mal du acquire a Lebenskraft Potion.

Se_Star_Aurena_I_RevealWorld.name: Anguillian Hypersense
Se_Star_Aurena_I_RevealWorld.description: When entering a Welt, reveal 3 random locations.

Se_Star_Aurena_L_ArmorOnLowHp.name: Feather Oil
Se_Star_Aurena_L_ArmorOnLowHp.description: Erhöht Rüstung um 30 when deine Lebenskraft is below 40%.

Se_Star_Aurena_L_HealAmpOnLowHp.name: Autophagy
Se_Star_Aurena_L_HealAmpOnLowHp.description: Erhöht Heilung given und received um 15% when deine Lebenskraft is below 50%.

Se_Star_Aurena_L_HealAmpWithPenalty.name: Experimental Hypothesis
Se_Star_Aurena_L_HealAmpWithPenalty.description: Erhöht Schaden erlitten from Gegner um 20%, but increases Heilung given und received um 15% .

Se_Star_Aurena_L_ShareHeal.name: Circulating Life
Se_Star_Aurena_L_ShareHeal.description: Wenn du Lebenskraft regenerierst, heilen a nahen Verbündeten other than dich selbst mit den niedrigsten Lebenskraft for 20% of den amount healed.

Se_Star_Aurena_L_SpeedOnDamage.name: Eel-like Agility
Se_Star_Aurena_L_SpeedOnDamage.description: When du erleiden Schaden, dein Bewegungstempo erhöht sich um 10% für 2 Sekunden.

Se_Star_Bismuth_D_AtkSpdFromDismantle.name: Enlightenment
Se_Star_Bismuth_D_AtkSpdFromDismantle.description: Jedes Mal du dismantle a Erinnerung or Essenz, deine Angriffsgeschwindigkeit increases permanently um 3% , but Traumstaub gained wird verringert um 35%. Angriffsgeschwindigkeit erhöhen varies um rarity: 70%, 100%, 150%, 300%. If Bismuth does not have multiple copies of den same Reisender Erinnerung, den amount of Angriffsgeschwindigkeit gained ist erhöht um 50%.

Se_Star_Bismuth_D_BonusAttackEffect.name: Arrow of the Mind
Se_Star_Bismuth_D_BonusAttackEffect.description: Deine Maximale Lebenskraft wird verringert um 15%, but in return, deine Standardangriffe have a 25% chance to fire an additional arrow das triggers an Angriff Effect. If Bismuth does not have multiple copies of den same Reisender Erinnerung, Maximale Lebenskraft is not reduced.

Se_Star_Bismuth_D_Conquerer.name: Mental Attunement
Se_Star_Bismuth_D_Conquerer.description: Erhalte 1 stack of Attunement mit each Standardangriffe, up to 8 stacks. Each stack increases deine Angriffskraft und Zauberkraft um 0.5 . Alle stacks are lost when du erleiden Schaden from Gegner.

Se_Star_Bismuth_D_SkillHasteAndAutoCast.name: Self-Writing Story
Se_Star_Bismuth_D_SkillHasteAndAutoCast.description: Erhöht Erinnerungstempo um 8 und most Erinnerungen will be automatically cast during combat.

Se_Star_Bismuth_F_DM_BonusOnFullCharge.name: Overcharge
Se_Star_Bismuth_F_DM_BonusOnFullCharge.description: Erhöht Distorted Mind's Abklingzeit um 1 seconds, but firing at maximum Aufladung increases den number of arrows um 2.

Se_Star_Bismuth_F_DM_MoreShootNoMove.name: Artillery
Se_Star_Bismuth_F_DM_MoreShootNoMove.description: Erhöht den maximum number of arrows for Distorted Mind um 7, but du cannot move während charging.

Se_Star_Bismuth_F_DM_NonFullChargeCooldo.name: Improvisation
Se_Star_Bismuth_F_DM_NonFullChargeCooldo.description: When du release Distorted Mind without fully charging, its Abklingzeit wird verringert um 50%.

Se_Star_Bismuth_F_IN_Elementals.name: Diverse Topics
Se_Star_Bismuth_F_IN_Elementals.description: Each soul missile from Pure Soul erhält a random elemental effect.

Se_Star_Bismuth_F_IN_LessCooldownLessMis.name: Undervolting
Se_Star_Bismuth_F_IN_LessCooldownLessMis.description: Pure Soul's soul missile count wird verringert um 2, but its Abklingzeit wird verringert um 50%.

Se_Star_Bismuth_F_IN_MoreProjByAtkSpd.name: Say Hello to My Little Friends!
Se_Star_Bismuth_F_IN_MoreProjByAtkSpd.description: Pure Soul's Abklingzeit erhöht sich um 2 seconds, but den number of soul missiles also erhöht sich um deine Angriffe pro Sekunde. If Bismuth does not have multiple copies of den same Reisender Erinnerung, den Abklingzeit is not increased.

Se_Star_Bismuth_F_IT_AddedDurationOnHit.name: Extended Agony
Se_Star_Bismuth_F_IT_AddedDurationOnHit.description: Tales of Hellfire's Abklingzeit erhöht sich um 1 seconds, but jedes Mal it einen Gegner trifft, its duration erhöht sich um 0.2 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 seconds.

Se_Star_Bismuth_F_IT_InnerDamage.name: Furnace
Se_Star_Bismuth_F_IT_InnerDamage.description: Tales of Hellfire's Schaden wird verringert um 40% but now also hits Gegner inside den ring.

Se_Star_Bismuth_F_IT_SmallerRingMoreDama.name: Close and Personal
Se_Star_Bismuth_F_IT_SmallerRingMoreDama.description: Tales of Hellfire's ring radius wird verringert um 35% but its Schaden ist erhöht um 35%.

Se_Star_Bismuth_F_VH_FullCharge.name: No Longer Afraid
Se_Star_Bismuth_F_VH_FullCharge.description: Valiant Heart's Aufladungen now fully stellt her alle at once.

Se_Star_Bismuth_F_VH_ResetOnDodge.name: Quick Decision
Se_Star_Bismuth_F_VH_ResetOnDodge.description: Using Distorting Sprint resets den Abklingzeit of Valiant Heart, but it only hits up to 2 Gegner.

Se_Star_Bismuth_F_VH_Shield.name: Steadfast Heart
Se_Star_Bismuth_F_VH_Shield.description: Valiant Heart's Abklingzeit ist erhöht um 1 seconds, but du erhalte a Barriere equal to 30% of den Schaden verursacht die anhält für 2.5 Sekunden. If Bismuth does not have multiple copies of den same Reisender Erinnerung, den amount of Barriere gained ist erhöht um 100%.

Se_Star_Bismuth_I_DismantleMemoryDreamDu.name: Good Material
Se_Star_Bismuth_I_DismantleMemoryDreamDu.description: Erhöhe den amount of Traumstaub obtained when dismantling Erinnerungen um 20% .

Se_Star_Bismuth_I_KnowledgeBook.name: Book of Knowledge
Se_Star_Bismuth_I_KnowledgeBook.description: Erhalte 1-4 Books of Knowledge for every boss du defeat. Each book grants a random stat equivalent to a Common-grade Chaos 15% . If Bismuth does not have multiple copies of den same Reisender Erinnerung, den amount of stats gained ist erhöht um 50%.

Se_Star_Bismuth_I_RevealWorld.name: Mind's Eye
Se_Star_Bismuth_I_RevealWorld.description: When entering a Welt, reveal 2 random locations.

Se_Star_Bismuth_I_SecretJournal.name: Secret Diary
Se_Star_Bismuth_I_SecretJournal.description: Start deine Abenteuers mit den Our Story Essenz. Its quality erhöht sich um 50% every time du defeat 75 Gegner und is completed when quality reaches 500%. When completed, this Essenz increases Bismuth's Zauberkraft und Angriffskraft um 10% , und enhances alle buffs from Distorting Sprint um 30% .

Se_Star_Bismuth_I_ShopDiscount.name: I'm Adorable

Se_Star_Bismuth_L_SecondWindWithPenalty.name: Two Souls
Se_Star_Bismuth_L_SecondWindWithPenalty.description: Wenn du tödlichen Schaden erleidest, ignorierst du diesen und wirst für 1 Sekunden unverwundbar. However, a random Erinnerung is destroyed, und Identity Erinnerungen may also be destroyed. This can only occur once per game.

Se_Star_Husk_D_DamageAmpOnLowHpTarget.name: Merciless
Se_Star_Husk_D_DamageAmpOnLowHpTarget.description: Alle Schaden verursacht an Gegner mit Lebenskraft below 35% ist erhöht um 15% .

Se_Star_Husk_D_DamageOverTimeCritWithPen.name: Life Neglect

Se_Star_Husk_D_DarkAttackWithPenalty.name: Soul Oil

Se_Star_Husk_D_MovementSkillHaste.name: Soul Acceleration

Se_Star_Husk_D_ScalingAdAndAtkSpd.name: Perceive, Learn, Adapt

Se_Star_Husk_F_AS_AddedDurationOnHit.name: Chained Bloodlust

Se_Star_Husk_F_AS_NonUltimate.name: Controlled Madness

Its Sword Energy Schaden und Angriffskraft bonus are verringert um 40%, it lasts für 4 Sekunden, und it no longer increases deine Dodge skill's Erinnerungstempo und Max Aufladungen.

Se_Star_Husk_F_AS_NoShockwaveFasterAttac.name: Frenzied Blade Dance

Se_Star_Husk_F_LA_DodgeResetOnRed.name: Flow of Energy

Se_Star_Husk_F_LA_SingleTargetCooldown.name: Precise Strike

Se_Star_Husk_L_FatalHitProtectionWithPen.name: Emergency Repair
Se_Star_Husk_L_FatalHitProtectionWithPen.description: Wenn du tödlichen Schaden erleidest, ignorierst du diesen und wirst für 1 Sekunden unverwundbar, but deine Maximale Lebenskraft wird verringert um 15%. This can only occur once per game.

Se_Star_Mist_I_StartGoldWithPenalty.description: Du begin deine Abenteuers mit 150 Gold, but den Gold price of Händler items ist erhöht um 10%.

Se_Star_Mist_L_MovSpeed.description: Bewegungstempo ist erhöht um 3% . When deine Lebenskraft is above 90%, this effect ist erhöht um 50%.

Se_Star_Nachia_D_CanineLover.name: Dog Lover

Se_Star_Vesper_L_ArmorOnLowHealth.description: When Lebenskraft is below 35%, erhalte 10 Rüstung.

Se_Star_Vesper_L_EmpowerDodgeShield.name: Heavy Armor Mastery
Se_Star_Vesper_L_EmpowerDodgeShield.description: Erhöht den Barriere amount of Heavy Strike um 45% und extends its duration um 75% .

Se_Star_Vesper_L_FireResistance.name: Heart of the Sun
Se_Star_Vesper_L_FireResistance.description: Verringert Feuerschaden erlitten um 30% und Verbrennung Schaden over time erlitten um 50% .

Se_Star_Vesper_L_ScalingArmor.name: Rising Faith
Se_Star_Vesper_L_ScalingArmor.description: Erhalte 2 Rüstung jedes Mal du erreichst Stufe 5, 10, 15, und 20.

Se_Star_Vesper_L_ScalingHealth.name: Marvelous Muscles
Se_Star_Vesper_L_ScalingHealth.description: Erhöht Maximale Lebenskraft um 15 jedes Mal du Stufenaufstieg.

Se_Star_Vesper_L_SlowSpeedMoreHealth.name: No Armor Is Too Thick
Se_Star_Vesper_L_SlowSpeedMoreHealth.description: Verringert Bewegungstempo um 20%, but increases Maximale Lebenskraft um 14% .

Se_Star_Yubar_D_APOnDodge.name: Singularity Reversal
Se_Star_Yubar_D_APOnDodge.description: Casting Dodge grants 12% Zauberkraft für 2 Sekunden.

Se_Star_Yubar_D_ADAPWithPenalty.name: Glass Cannon
Se_Star_Yubar_D_ADAPWithPenalty.description: Erhalte 5 Angriffskraft und 7 Zauberkraft, but deine Maximale Lebenskraft wird verringert um 15%.

Se_Star_Yubar_D_APPerLightSkill.name: Starlit Gaze
Se_Star_Yubar_D_APPerLightSkill.description: Erhalte 2 Zauberkraft for each Lichtschaden Erinnerung du possess.

Se_Star_Yubar_D_BonusDamageToLight.name: Starlit Eyes
Se_Star_Yubar_D_BonusDamageToLight.description: Erhöht alle Schaden verursacht an Gegner mit 5 or more stacks of Light um 10% .

Se_Star_Yubar_D_ConvertADToAP.name: Eclipse
Se_Star_Yubar_D_ConvertADToAP.description: Erhalte Zauberkraft equal to 25% of deine Angriffskraft.

Se_Star_Yubar_D_ScalingAP.name: Dazzling Meteor
Se_Star_Yubar_D_ScalingAP.description: Erhalte 3 Zauberkraft jedes Mal du erreichst Stufen 5, 10, 15, und 20.

Se_Star_Yubar_F_CC_DamageOverTime.name: Burning Meteor
Se_Star_Yubar_F_CC_DamageOverTime.description: Der impact site of Cataclysm's meteor burns, verursacht 100% of den meteor's Schaden to Gegner über 2 Sekunden.

Se_Star_Yubar_F_CC_IncreaseAD.name: Choosing Violence
Se_Star_Yubar_F_CC_IncreaseAD.description: Cataclysm increases Yubar's Angriffskraft und Angriffsgeschwindigkeit stattdessen of Zauberkraft.

Se_Star_Yubar_F_CC_MeteorPerLightSkill.name: Galactic Shower
Se_Star_Yubar_F_CC_MeteorPerLightSkill.description: Der number of meteors das can be dropped mit Cataclysm ist erhöht um 1 for each other Light Erinnerung Yubar possesses.

Se_Star_Yubar_F_EI_AutoExplosion.name: Unstable Ether
Se_Star_Yubar_F_EI_AutoExplosion.description: Ether's Influence's explosion Schaden wird verringert um 60% und can no longer be detonated manually, but it now explodes automatically bei Treffer.

Se_Star_Yubar_F_EI_BiggerExplosion.name: Explosive Confidence
Se_Star_Yubar_F_EI_BiggerExplosion.description: Ether's Influence's explosion radius ist erhöht um 25%.

Se_Star_Yubar_F_EI_NoRootMoreDamage.name: Flow Reversal
Se_Star_Yubar_F_EI_NoRootMoreDamage.description: Ether's Influence no longer roots Gegner but its explosion Schaden ist erhöht um 50%.

Se_Star_Yubar_F_SN_Artillery.name: Mortar
Se_Star_Yubar_F_SN_Artillery.description: Erhöht Supernova's cast range um 40% und explosion radius um 30%.

Se_Star_Yubar_F_SN_AutoExplosion.name: Star Herding
Se_Star_Yubar_F_SN_AutoExplosion.description: Supernova can no longer be manually detonated. Channeling is removed und it now automatically explodes when fully charged.

Se_Star_Yubar_F_SN_DodgeReset.name: Swift Casting
Se_Star_Yubar_F_SN_DodgeReset.description: Casting Supernova resets den Abklingzeit of Dodge.

Se_Star_Yubar_F_TQ_EssenceCooldown.name: Song of Stars
Se_Star_Yubar_F_TQ_EssenceCooldown.description: Tranquility's Abklingzeit ist erhöht um 2 seconds, but it also verringert den cooldowns of alle essences.

Se_Star_Yubar_F_TQ_LowerCooldownNoInvul.name: Flexible Thinking
Se_Star_Yubar_F_TQ_LowerCooldownNoInvul.description: Tranquility's Abklingzeit wird verringert um 2 seconds, but stattdessen of becoming Invulnerable, du erhalte a Barriere equal to 100% of deine Maximale Lebenskraft die anhält for den duration of den Invulnerability.

Se_Star_Yubar_F_TQ_ReducedCooldownAndDur.name: Light Heart
Se_Star_Yubar_F_TQ_ReducedCooldownAndDur.description: Tranquility's Abklingzeit wird verringert um 4 seconds, but its Invulnerability duration is also verringert um 40%.

Se_Star_Yubar_I_DisintegrateDreamDust.name: Dream-born
Se_Star_Yubar_I_DisintegrateDreamDust.description: When using den Shrine of Dismantling, erhalte additional Traumstaub equal to 50% of den Gold received as a reward.

Se_Star_Yubar_I_MoreDreamDustWithPenalty.name: God in a Fairy Tale
Se_Star_Yubar_I_MoreDreamDustWithPenalty.description: Deine Maximale Lebenskraft wird verringert um 10%, but du erhalte 10% increased Traumstaub from alle sources.

Se_Star_Yubar_I_StarCookie.name: Cookie Baker
Se_Star_Yubar_I_StarCookie.description: Defeating Gegner has a 0.5% chance to create a Star Cookie. Star Cookies stellt her a small amount of Yubar's Lebenskraft und grant a small amount of Gold und Traumstaub.

Se_Star_Yubar_L_DodgeChargeWithLongerCoo.name: Stellar Trace
Se_Star_Yubar_L_DodgeChargeWithLongerCoo.description: Erhalte 1 additional Aufladung for Dodge, but its Abklingzeit ist erhöht um 2 seconds.

Se_Star_Yubar_L_DodgeCooldownWithShorter.name: Peek-a-boo!
Se_Star_Yubar_L_DodgeCooldownWithShorter.description: Dodge's Abklingzeit wird verringert um 0.8 seconds, but its travel distance wird verringert um 40% .

Se_Star_Yubar_L_DodgeRange.name: Now You See Me
Se_Star_Yubar_L_DodgeRange.description: Der travel distance of Dodge ist erhöht um 33%.

Se_Star_D_CritUpHitDecay.name: Innate Focus
Se_Star_D_CritUpHitDecay.description: Erhalte 25% Crit Chance. Taking Schaden from Gegner permanently verringert this bonus um 1%. Verbrennung Schaden does not trigger this reduction.

Se_Star_D_RiftFirstCastDamageUp.name: Vanguard Banner
Se_Star_D_RiftFirstCastDamageUp.description: Every time du travel through a Rift, den Schaden of den first Erinnerung du cast ist erhöht um 90% .

Se_Star_I_DismantleDustToBonusGold.name: Paradigm Shift
Se_Star_I_DismantleDustToBonusGold.description: Erhalte Gold equal to 15% of den Traumstaub obtained when dismantling Erinnerungen or Essenzen.

Se_Star_I_ExtraChaosOptionGoldOnUse.name: Ordered Chaos
Se_Star_I_ExtraChaosOptionGoldOnUse.description: Erhöht Chaos options um 1, und grants 15 Gold when using Chaos.

Se_Star_I_FirstBossGemDrop.name: Someone's Treasure
Se_Star_I_FirstBossGemDrop.description: Upon defeating den first Heroic Boss, du erhalte 1 Common Essenzen of 10% quality.

Se_Star_L_IncreaseMaxHealthByGuidance.name: Boundless Blessing of the Great Guide
Se_Star_L_IncreaseMaxHealthByGuidance.description: Activating a Shrine of Guidance increases Maximale Lebenskraft um 20 . Activating a Blessed Shrine of Guidance increases it um 50 .

Se_Star_L_MaxHealthUpHealDown.name: Thick Skin
Se_Star_L_MaxHealthUpHealDown.description: Erhöht Maximale Lebenskraft um 15% . Verringert Healing Received um 50%.

Se_Star_L_PostHitDamageImmune.name: Cowardly Doll
Se_Star_L_PostHitDamageImmune.description: Erhalte Schaden Immunity für 1 Sekunden after taking Schaden. Triggers once alle 14 Sekunden.
